description: This file defines the MyReviewController class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for handling employee performance reviews, specifically related to 'my-reviews'.

classes.name: MyReviewController
classes.description: Controller for handling personal review views, extending AbstractVueController to utilize Vue.js components within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component 'my-reviews' before rendering the view, setting it up for the frontend to display.
